_comment: Copy this file to camel-gate.local.json in the same directory and fill in the placeholders. That path is git-ignored: it is the only place a machine-specific value belongs. Keys you leave out keep the defaults in camel-gate-config.ps1.
sshHost: <the ssh alias or host name the gate connects to>
sshExe: <absolute path of ssh.exe, or leave out to use ssh from PATH>
scpExe: <absolute path of scp.exe, or leave out to use scp from PATH>
stateDir: <absolute path of the directory that holds build-state.json, test-state.json and run-registry.jsonl>
hostLibStdCxxDir: <absolute path, on the host, of the toolchain libstdc++ directory -- only for installs built before they carried their own>
watchRepo: <absolute path of the checkout watch-fsh-dev.ps1 follows>
